yd3n1bhz.sourceDescription: The Arbor Ultima Half Tree is one of the highest quality and most realistic trees available on the market today. pjww088f.variantName: Walplus 910 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 210 cm
pjww088f.sourceDescription: Our black artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. The steel feet add to its stability. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Additionally, It can be used both indoors and sheltered outdoors. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC, steel Total height: 210 cm Tree diameter: 110 cm With 910 tips Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
